answer_to_user: Resolved to Nestlé S.A. (NESN.SW, Switzerland). Its current (TTM, as-of 2026-06-30) P/E is 27.4x. Over the last several fiscal years it printed pe 24x (FY2023), 16x (FY2024) and 19x (FY2025). So NO - on this data Nestlé is NOT cheap versus its own recent history: at ~27x it is trading ABOVE the 16-24x range of the past three fiscal years, and above the FY2025 level of 19x. Note the multiple is elevated largely because earnings are falling (diluted EPS -16%, net income -17% year-on-year), which mechanically lifts P/E even without a richer share price. Figures are in CHF; P/E is price/earnings on reported net income.
